propositions: Rebar must safely pass provider-native credentials through operation snapshots without storing, caching, or logging credential values or refresh tokens
Static credential rotation for long-running processes requires restart/redeploy; Rebar does not implement polling, file watching, or hot-reload mechanisms
Deployment must resolve external secret stores (SSM, keyring, file) before process startup and inject exactly one credential source via environment or file path
Subprocess children inherit ambient environment for native Git/SSH/AWS chains while exact Rebar-declared secret variable names are removed from unrelated siblings
Unavoidable static credentials use Pydantic SecretStr/SecretBytes only in provider-specific non-serializable containers excluded from snapshots, caching, and fingerprints

Rebar constructs and owns official SDK clients (boto3 Session, Anthropic, OpenAI) that receive pre-client credential capabilities rather than accepting arbitrary fully-constructed clients that could bypass retry/timeout/cache/lifecycle policy
